outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, and individual data points (colored dots for SCLC, LUSC, LUAD samples) are overlaid on each bar, showing the underlying biological replicates.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the experimental workflow (Ad-Cre administration, MRI imaging, sacrifice), not a data plot.
Panel C shows representative MRI images of mice, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrographs of mouse lung tissue, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope zoom-in micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
